# Story 12 — Enhance form controls and form layout (Story: 12)

## Prerequisites

- None. The shared form primitives (`TextInput`, `PasswordInput`, `Checkbox`, `Select`, `EmailInput`, `FormActions`, `FormError`), the `useForm` hook and the design tokens referenced below already exist and are the surfaces this story mutates. No backend work.
- Coordinate with the owner of `frontend/src/features/design-system/TokensPage.tsx` — this story adds new sections there.

---

## Story Goal

Bring the form system up to the intake's specification:

1. Constrain every text input to a comfortable measure (single-column ≤ 480 px, auth screens 400 px, textarea/rich-text full width) and group the sign-in and register screens inside a centred card so labels, controls, submit button and supporting links sit within the same viewport region.
2. Move the password visibility toggle to the trailing edge of the input in both LTR and RTL, and expose its pressed state via `aria-pressed`.
3. Extend the primitive controls (label, hint, error, states, required marking, autofill styling, `dir="ltr"` for email/phone/code inputs, live-region summary linkage) so every AC1–AC16 rule is enforced at the component level rather than the caller.
4. Deliver the missing library controls listed in the intake (`TextArea`, `Radio` + `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `SearchField`, `FormRow`, `FormSection`, plus layout wrappers) and document all of them on the tokens/design-system page with axe checks green.
5. Add an unsaved-changes guard usable by any form and wire the two auth pages to the new layout primitives without regressing existing tests.

**Out of scope:** file upload, rich-text editor, multi-step wizard navigation, password-policy checklist content (fed by the backend policy endpoint), and building the still-optional `Combobox`, `MultiSelect` and `DatePicker` controls — leave a documented placeholder for them but do **not** implement in this story.

## Product rules (from story)

| Concern | Current behaviour | New behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Field maximum width | Stretches with parent; auth inputs fill the viewport (~1900 px). | Single-column `≤ 480 px`; auth card `= 400 px`; textarea/rich-text = full width. Two-column form only above `768px` breakpoint. |
| Auth screen layout | Bare `<main>`, no card. | Centred card, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `surface-sunken` page background; logo, heading, form, primary action, remember-me and supporting links all inside the card. |
| Password toggle position | Sits at fixed end via `endIcon` slot; no `aria-pressed`. | Sits on the input's **trailing edge** in both LTR & RTL (already true because it uses logical `endIcon` layout — verify with an RTL test) and carries `aria-pressed={visible}`. |
| Required marking | `*` visually only. | Visual `*` **plus** `aria-required="true"`, and one "* fields are required" note per form. |
| Validation timing | Mixed: `SignInPage` uses `blur-then-live`; `RegisterPage` uses `submit`. | Every form in scope of this story uses `blur-then-live`. |
| Server field errors | Never mapped — all thrown as `submitError`. | New helper maps `error.fieldErrors[path]` onto per-field `errors[path]`; unknown paths fall back to the top banner (AC10). |
| Autofilled appearance | Browser yellow. | Overridden via `:-webkit-autofill` box-shadow trick in `TextInput.module.css` (AC13). |
| Fields during submit | Not disabled (SignInPage) / not disabled (RegisterPage) — already correct. | Formalise: never set `disabled` on inputs while `isSubmitting`; only the submit button uses `loading`. |
| Unsaved-changes navigation | No guard. | New `useUnsavedChangesGuard(dirty: boolean)` hook that installs a `beforeunload` listener and a `unstable_useBlocker` router prompt. |
| Email/phone/code direction | Inherits `dir` from HTML root. | Force `dir="ltr"` and `text-align: start` on `EmailInput`, `SearchField` (when `inputMode="tel" | "numeric"`), and a new `CodeInput`. |

### 1 — Extend `TextInput` with the missing states, props and tokens

**File:** `frontend/src/shared/components/form/TextInput.tsx`

- Add optional props: `readOnly?: boolean`, `disabled?: boolean` (pass through), `dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl' | 'auto'`, `descriptionId?: string`, `maxWidth?: 'field' | 'wide' | 'full'` (defaults to `'field'`).
- When `readOnly` is set, forward `readOnly` and `aria-readonly="true"` on the native input.
- Set `aria-required={required}` on the input (in addition to the native `required`), and only render the visible `*` when `required` is true (AC7).
- Compose `aria-describedby` from `descriptionId`, `hintId`, `errorId` in that order.
- Wrap the field in a container whose `max-inline-size` maps to the CSS classes below.

**File:** `frontend/src/shared/components/form/TextInput.module.css`

- Change label `font-size` from `--text-xs` to `--text-sm`, weight stays medium (matches intake anatomy).
- Change wrapper `border-radius` from `--radius-md` to `--radius-sm` (matches intake anatomy).
- Set wrapper `min-block-size: 40px` (matches "40 px tall" anatomy) via `padding-block: var(--space-sm)` on the input plus explicit height rule.
- Add:
  - `.field[data-max-width='field'] { max-inline-size: 480px; }`
  - `.field[data-max-width='wide']  { max-inline-size: 720px; }`
  - `.field[data-max-width='full']  { max-inline-size: 100%; }`
- Add `:hover` (`border-color: var(--color-border-input-hover)`), `:disabled` (`background: var(--color-surface-disabled); color: var(--color-text-disabled)`), `[aria-invalid='true']` (`border-color: var(--color-danger)`), `[aria-readonly='true']` (`background: var(--color-surface-sunken)`) states on `.inputWrapper` / `.input`.
- Autofill override (AC13):
  ```css
  .input:-webkit-autofill,
  .input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
  .input:-webkit-autofill:focus {
    -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-text-default);
    -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--color-surface) inset;
    transition: background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
  }
  ```
- If `--color-border-input-hover` or `--color-surface-disabled` aliases are missing from `frontend/src/shared/theme/tokens.ts`, add them (verify by grep first — do not duplicate existing tokens).

**Guard-rail:** every existing `<TextInput>` caller must keep working without adding new required props.

### 7 — Server-error → field mapping

**File:** `frontend/src/shared/validation/useForm.ts`

- Add a new result method `setFieldErrors(errors: Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>): void` and `setFormError(message: string | null): void` so a caller can push `error.fieldErrors` into per-field state without touching internal setters.
- Do **not** change the meaning of `mode`, `firstInvalidField()` or `submitError`. The old signature must remain intact.
- Update `frontend/src/shared/validation/useForm.test.ts` (14 KB near-by test file — confirm path with grep) to cover the two new setters. If it does not exist yet, add coverage in the story's Test Plan.

**Create helper:** `frontend/src/shared/validation/applyServerErrors.ts`

```ts
export function applyServerErrors<T extends Record<string, string>>(
  fieldErrors: Record<string, string> | undefined,
  known: readonly (keyof T)[],
  push: {
    setFieldErrors: (errs: Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>) => void;
    setFormError: (message: string | null) => void;
  },
  fallbackKey: string,
): void;
```

Behaviour: for every key in `fieldErrors` that appears in `known`, push it to `setFieldErrors`; if any key is not recognised, aggregate them into the form-level banner via `setFormError(fallbackKey)` so nothing is silently dropped (AC10).

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Password toggle in RTL:** the eye icon must sit on the left edge of the input in Arabic. Enforced by rendering the toggle in the `endIcon` slot of a `TextInput` whose flex direction inherits document `dir`; verify by mounting `PasswordInput` inside `<LocaleProvider locale="ar">` in `PasswordInput.test.tsx` and asserting the button appears **before** the input in DOM order — see `frontend/src/shared/components/form/PasswordInput.tsx` after task 2.
- **Card overflow on tiny viewports:** at widths below `400px` the card must shrink with the viewport (use `inline-size: min(400px, 100% - var(--space-md) * 2)`). Enforce in `SignInPage.module.css`.
- **`beforeunload` firing during programmatic redirect after successful submit:** the guard must be disarmed *before* `navigate(...)` runs. Achieve by clearing values via `resetField` and gating `isDirty` on `Object.values(values).some(Boolean) && !isSubmitting`.
- **Two rapid submits:** `useForm.handleSubmit` already guards via `submitting` ref (`useForm.ts` line 135). Do not remove this guard.
- **Unknown server field paths:** must fall through to the form-level banner. Enforced in `applyServerErrors` (task 7); assert in tests.
- **Autofill in Chrome / Safari:** without the `-webkit-autofill` override the yellow default is visible. Enforced in `TextInput.module.css` (task 1).
- **Password manager fill on `RegisterPage`:** the second `<PasswordInput autoComplete="new-password">` must remain distinct from the first so managers do not overwrite it — verify by mounting the register page and asserting each password field has the right `autoComplete` attribute.
- **Reduced-motion:** the `Switch` thumb transition must collapse to zero duration under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
- **RTL summary banner:** `FormError`/summary text must inherit `dir` from the document root; do not set `dir` on the banner itself (G7).
- **`unstable_useBlocker` outside a Data Router:** `useUnsavedChangesGuard` must no-op (not throw) when the router does not provide the blocker — fall back to `beforeunload` only.
- **Locale switcher moved outside the card:** ensure existing tests that query `getByRole('button', { name: /english/i })` still find the switcher (path unchanged, only the CSS parent changes).
- **Sign-in banner state (`signedOut=1`):** the `showSignedOutBanner` message must render **inside** the card, above the heading, so the user does not miss it — verify in `SignInPage.test.tsx`.

## Migration / Rollback

- No schema, config or API change. Roll back by reverting the frontend commit; there is no persisted state that outlives a bad build.
- Half-applied risk: if the new tokens (`--color-border-input-hover`, `--color-surface-disabled`) are added in `tokens.ts` but the CSS references are not shipped, no visual regression occurs — the tokens are only referenced by the new CSS. Ship the CSS and TS changes together.
- If the `useUnsavedChangesGuard` breaks navigation, feature-gate it by returning early from the hook (`if (!import.meta.env.PROD) return;`) as an emergency mitigation, then investigate.

1. **Frontend runs:** from `frontend/`, `pnpm install` then `pnpm dev`; open `/sign-in` at ≥ 1280 px and confirm the card is centred at 400 px, the submit button spans the card, and the password toggle sits on the trailing edge in both `?lang=en` and `?lang=ar`.

5. **Axe:** the `TokensPage.axe.test.tsx` run must remain green (G11).
6. **Regression:** manually run through `/sign-in` (invalid credentials, lockout, rate-limited, signed-out banner), `/register` (unsaved-changes prompt on browser tab close), and confirm no design-system page regression by scrolling every section.

- [ ] AC2 — every input carries a programmatically associated `<label>`; placeholder is never the only label.
- [ ] AC3 — text inputs enforce `max-inline-size: 480px` (or narrower on the auth card) and never stretch to the viewport width.
- [ ] AC4 — `/sign-in` and `/register` render inside a centred `400px` card with logo, heading, form, submit and supporting links inside the card.
- [ ] AC5 — password toggle sits on the input's trailing edge in LTR and RTL, and exposes `aria-pressed`.
- [ ] AC6 — checkbox and radio precede their labels in reading order; RTL test asserts the swap.
- [ ] AC7 — required fields carry visual `*` **and** `aria-required="true"`, plus one `forms.requiredNote` line per form.
- [ ] AC8 — every form uses `mode: 'blur-then-live'`; failed submit focuses the first invalid field.
- [ ] AC9 — errors are linked via `aria-describedby`, fields carry `aria-invalid`, and the summary banner uses `role="alert"` + `aria-live="assertive"`.
- [ ] AC10 — server field errors route through `applyServerErrors`; unknown paths land in the form-level banner rather than being dropped.
- [ ] AC11 — `EmailInput` and `CodeInput` render `dir="ltr"` even inside `<LocaleProvider locale="ar">`.
- [ ] AC12 — `PasswordInput` accepts paste and preserves `autoComplete` (`current-password` / `new-password`).
- [ ] AC13 — autofilled inputs keep the designed background (verified via the `:-webkit-autofill` override).
- [ ] AC14 — during submit the submit button spins; inputs remain enabled.
- [ ] AC15 — `useUnsavedChangesGuard` warns before navigating away from a dirty `/register` form.
- [ ] AC16 — `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `SearchField` and the existing `Select` are operable by keyboard with the expected bindings.
- [ ] G1–G11 — each item verified against the "Forms" section of `TokensPage.tsx`; axe test green.
- [ ] All prior `SignInPage.test.tsx` and `RegisterPage.test.tsx` assertions still pass unchanged.
